name: DataForSEO
one_liner: REST API suite for SEO and search data: SERPs, keywords, backlinks, on-page, and more.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic with API login and API-generated password from app.dataforseo.com/api-access (different from account password). MCP HTTP mode also supports OAuth 2.0.
access_notes: Free account gives credentials and free Sandbox; real calls draw on prepaid balance, pay-as-you-go with $50 minimum top-up, no subscriptions.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve Basic-auth credentials, documented REST API, free sandbox, but live calls need a prepaid balance ($50 minimum top-up).

auth.quote: Create a free account with DataForSEO, then go to the API Access tab in the account dashboard to find your API login and password

sandbox.quote: Sandbox is completely free for any registered user at DataForSEO.

api_surface.quote: Sandbox environment also works with pingback_url and postback_url functions.
The general rate limit for DataForSEO API is 10,000 requests per minute.

mcp.quote: MCP server and CLI for LLM agents to browse DataForSEO API documentation and make authenticated API requests.

disputes.why: Auth docs show Authorization Basic with base64 login:password from API Access tab.
Free account and sandbox, but pay-as-you-go prepaid with $50 minimum top-up for live calls.
Credentials are clear; the gate is prepaid balance.
